source.method: Chrome DevTools MCP: computed styles, CSS rules, CSS variables, rAF/event sampling on iframe reaction bar

importantCorrections: Black tooltip has NO bounce/scale/rotate of its own. transform is always none. animation is none. getAnimations() is empty.
animation-1yp4gtl (1200ms cubic-bezier(1,0,0,1) fly/bounce) belongs to timeline flying emoji after send (.css-1hs3ddr), NOT the hover tooltip.
Tooltip sits INSIDE the emoji hover wrapper, so it rides the emoji's scale(1.3) translateY(-6px) rotate(Ndeg).
Emoji rotate is random per hover, not a fixed per-emoji matrix. Observed integers from -5deg to +5deg.
CSS opacity 150ms 50ms exists on the wrap but opacity stays 1 in both hidden and shown states; show/hide is display none ↔ block, so fade is a no-op.

domTree.note: Tooltip is a sibling of the button, both inside the transforming wrapper.
structure: inline style on hover: transform: scale(1.3) translate(0px, -6px) rotate(Ndeg);
div.css-uu6h57  data-lens-theme=light data-color-mode=light  (forces inverse = dark chip)

tokens.fontFamily: "Atlassian Sans", ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, "system-ui", "Segoe UI", Ubuntu, system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif

tooltipBox.role: visual black chip; not a native title tooltip

visualSizeWhenParentScaled13.note: getBoundingClientRect includes parent scale(1.3) and rotate

tooltipWrap.transitionNote: Both states keep opacity:1, so the fade never paints. Show/hide is display toggle / remount.

label.text: emoji short name lowercase, e.g. fire / heart / yes / clap / yay / eyes

shortcutChip.text: keyboard shortcut 1–6 for the six quick reactions

seek.note: progress bar. Scaled tooltip overlaps it (tooltip top ~421).

quickGrid.note: li / wrapper / button are all exactly 32×32. 8px between boxes is dead space (no hover).

tooltipUnscaled.widthIdentity: 24 + labelW + 8 + chipW  (12px padding each side). Integer offsetWidth used for left.
tooltipUnscaled.doNotHardcodeWidths: Let text measure; then left = (32 - offsetWidth) / 2. Odd widths produce x.5 left.

pixelLayout.transformOriginWorld: button center = wrapper (x+16, y+16). Fire origin (431.5, 502.5).

scaledFireExample.note: cx stays on origin only if rotate=0. Nonzero rotate swings the tooltip around origin 16,16 so visual center drifts a few px. This is required, not a bug.

appear.type: instant display:block on the NEW wrapper
appear.note: Tooltip mounts at identity, then rides the 100ms hover-in. It does not start already scaled.

disappear.type: instant display:none / unmount on pointerleave, BEFORE the emoji eases down

switchBetweenEmojis.tooltipXInterpolation: NONE. No FLIP, no slide, no shared floating layer.
switchBetweenEmojis.tooltipJump: Unmount on old wrapper and mount on new wrapper in the same frame (~20ms).
switchBetweenEmojis.then: Same 100ms ease-in-out as the new emoji hover-in, because it is a child of that wrapper.
switchBetweenEmojis.oldEmoji: starts CSSTransition 1.3N → identity in the same frame
switchBetweenEmojis.newEmoji: starts CSSTransition identity → 1.3N' in the same frame
switchBetweenEmojis.scaleSumInvariant: oldScale + newScale = 2.3 for the whole 100ms (both share progress p: 1.3-0.3p and 1+0.3p)
switchBetweenEmojis.rotateIndependent: old N eases to 0; new rolls a fresh N' and eases 0 → N'
switchBetweenEmojis.paintOrder: later DOM (rightward emoji) composites on top during overlap

gapBetweenHitTargets.whileInGap: tooltip already gone; previous emoji still easing 1.3 → 1
gapBetweenHitTargets.enteringNext: new tooltip appears at scale 1 while previous may still be mid-ease-out
gapBetweenHitTargets.visual: fast mouse across 8px (~8ms) almost hides the blink; slow cross shows a blank tooltip gap

parentHoverMakesTooltip.rotateDeg: same random N as emoji, typically -5..5
parentHoverMakesTooltip.onePropertyOnly: Do not split scale/rotate/translate into separate transitions. Interpolate a single transform list: none ↔ scale(1.3) translate(0,-6px) rotate(Ndeg).
parentHoverMakesTooltip.note: This is the only motion the black box has.

sampledCurves.note: progress is WAAPI transformed progress after easing. scale = 1 + 0.3 * progress on hover-in; reverse on hover-out. ty = -7.8 * progress. rot = N * progress.
sampledCurves.hoverOut: exact reverse of hoverIn on the same 100ms ease-in-out
sampledCurves.sameFrameSwitch: old.progress === new.progress every sample (heart/eyes skip switch matched to 6 decimals)

emojiButton.steadyComputed: matrix(1.3*cosN, 1.3*sinN, -1.3*sinN, 1.3*cosN, 0, -7.8)  [ty may be slightly less than -7.8 mid-transition]

glyph.content: Twemoji / Apple Color Emoji native emoji character, not SVG
glyph.color: rgb(206, 207, 210) on span; button color white

timelineFlyOnSend.note: Do not apply these keyframes to the black hover tooltip.

replicaContract.quickGrid: grid-cols 32px × 6, gap-x 8px, h-32, no hit slop over the 8px gutter
replicaContract.tooltipSurface: h-[34px] rounded-[6px] bg-[#292A2E] px-3 py-[7px] text-white shadow-[0_4px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] whitespace-nowrap
replicaContract.tooltipOffset: absolute top-[-38px]; left = (32px - offsetWidth) / 2; equivalent rest gap 4px above the 32px button
replicaContract.label: h-5 pt-0.5 text-[12px]/[18px] font-[653] text-white
replicaContract.shortcutChip: h-5 rounded-[3px] bg-[rgb(11_18_14/0.14)] px-1 text-[12px]/[18px] font-[653] text-[#DDDEE1] pt-0.5
replicaContract.showHide: display/mount toggle on the active wrapper only. Never fade, never FLIP x. Tooltip first paint is always scale(1).
replicaContract.emojiHover: ONE CSS transition: transform 100ms ease-in-out (cubic-bezier(0.42,0,0.58,1)), origin 16px 16px, fill backwards. Target: scale(1.3) translate(0px,-6px) rotate(random integer -5..5deg).
replicaContract.switchSameFrame: Clear old inline transform and set new inline transform in the same frame so both CSSTransitions share progress. scale_old + scale_new must stay 2.3.
doNot: delaying tooltip hide until emoji ease-out finishes
